exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Selective Exclusion
exploitedBy.relevance: Selective exclusion directly relates to ambiguous classification enforcement where certain data or assets may be inconsistently or selectively excluded from security controls.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Obfuscated Files or Information
exploitedBy.relevance: Ambiguous classification can allow obfuscation techniques to go undetected when data sensitivity labels are unclear or inconsistently applied.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Cloud Storage
exploitedBy.relevance: Undefined retention boundaries in cloud storage environments expose data to unauthorized access over extended unmanaged periods.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Stored Data Manipulation
exploitedBy.relevance: Without defined retention boundaries, temporarily stored data remains accessible and vulnerable to manipulation by adversaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Lifecycle-Triggered Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Lifecycle-triggered deletion is directly relevant as undefined temporary retention boundaries mean deletion policies are not properly configured or enforced.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Gather Victim Identity Information
exploitedBy.relevance: Missing PII anonymization or masking makes it easier for adversaries to gather victim identity information from exposed data stores.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Employee Names
exploitedBy.relevance: Unmasked PII directly enables adversaries to collect employee names and personal identifiers for targeting purposes.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data from Information Repositories
exploitedBy.relevance: Repositories lacking PII anonymization become high-value targets for adversaries seeking to extract personal information.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: File and Directory Permissions Modification
exploitedBy.relevance: Insufficient access controls on unclassified data can be exploited through permission modification techniques to escalate access.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Conditional Access Policies
exploitedBy.relevance: Insufficient access controls relate directly to inadequate or missing conditional access policies that fail to restrict unclassified data appropriately.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: File Deletion
exploitedBy.relevance: Inadequate disposal procedures fail to ensure secure file deletion, leaving transient data recoverable by adversaries.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Fileless Storage
exploitedBy.relevance: Fileless storage of transient data may be missed by inadequate disposal procedures that only target traditional file-based artifacts.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
exploitedBy.relevance: Transferring data to cloud accounts in different jurisdictions is a direct mechanism through which cross-border transfer compliance gaps are exploited.

exploitedBy.label: MitreAttackTechnique
exploitedBy.name: Data Staged
exploitedBy.relevance: Staging data prior to cross-border transfer is a technique that highlights compliance gaps when data is aggregated and moved without proper authorization.
